note: Cases for BOTH halves of the enum-refusal pair (widened.dmn, unwidened.dmn).
One cases file for two models on purpose: the halves differ in exactly one
token, so anything that differs in the RESULTS is attributable to that token
and to nothing else. Case A is the control (a value inside the enum, which
both halves and both engines answer identically); case B is the refusal.
`null` in `expect` LICENSES a null answer, so case B asserts that the model
DECLINED — it is not the absence of an expectation. On unwidened.dmn KIE
does not get that far: it raises
Invalid result value on rule #3, output #1. Value null does not match
and the decision comes back FAILED, which the harness scores red. That red
is the assertion, and the workflow step checks the message rather than the
exit code, because a harness that died before running also exits non-zero.

cases.name: A. control — a claim inside the declared band domain
B. THE REFUSAL — a claim below every band
